title: Login Request
description: POST /api/v1/auth/login credential body. additionalProperties:true — the backend reads email/password/mfa_token and ignores unknown keys.

mfa_token.description: MFA challenge code, supplied on the second leg of an MFA-gated login (after a 403 `mfa_required`): a 6-digit TOTP code or an unused recovery code (XXXX-XXXX). Re-send the same email and password.
